title: Hijrah and Madinah
outline: Key facts about Hijrah and Madinah
Important terms and examples in Hijrah and Madinah
Importance and application of Hijrah and Madinah

modules.title: Introduction to Hijrah and Madinah
modules.html:
The migration to Madinah, the brotherhood of Muhajirun and Ansar, the Constitution of Madinah, and the battles of Badr, Uhud and Khandaq. This section covers introduction to hijrah and madinah.

Key points

  • The 'Hijrah' calendar begins from the year the Prophet (SAW) migrated from _____ to _____. — Makkah to Madinah.
  • The 'Hijab' became mandatory for Muslim women in the _____ year after Hijrah. — 5th.
  • Hijrah was to: — Madinah.
  • The migration of the Prophet from Makkah to Madinah is called: — Hijrah.
  • The Prophet's mosque in Madinah is called: — Masjid al-Nabawi.

Worked examples

Q: The 'Hijrah' calendar begins from the year the Prophet (SAW) migrated from _____ to _____.
A: Makkah to Madinah — The Islamic (Hijri) era marks the migration to Madinah in 622 CE, which established the first Islamic state.

Q: The 'Hijab' became mandatory for Muslim women in the _____ year after Hijrah.
A: 5th — Most historical accounts state that the verses regarding Hijab were revealed in the 5th year of AH.
